tools.name: prepare_repository_handoff
tools.description: When preparing a user-authorized repository file handoff to another agent or reviewer, call with arguments such as {"entries":[{"path":"src/app.py","kind":"file"}]}. Send permitted relative filenames and kinds only; never file contents, secrets or URLs. Returns exact zero-based include/exclude/skip

tools.name: repository_safety_preflight
tools.description: Zero-effect repository path-metadata preflight. Never send contents, archives, URLs, callbacks, or secrets.

tools.name: diagnose_a2a_request
tools.description: Diagnose common A2A JSON-RPC SendMessage version and message-shape mistakes. Use when debugging an A2A integration. Send a sanitized request example and selected protocol version, never secrets or headers. Returns fixed field corrections and an authored template. Does not contact an endpoint or cert
